title: feat(cutsparse): F_cut support min is 36, not f_L1
science: Sparsity inside F_cut, plus the batch's most useful reference table and a NOTATION COLLISION worth flagging. Result: m_cut=36 attained by exactly one of the eight F_cut fillers, tuple (1,0,1,0,0) - again NOT f_L1 (supp 56). Gives the exact support formula supp = 12*wt1 + 6*opp2 + 24*adj2 + 8*vertex3 + 12*mixed3 (pair orbits counted with both members) and the full eight-row table of tuples, support
